text:
Leah: Ok team — last call to lock the webinar slate + run-of-show. Need: final topic order, speakers confirmed, who owns the demo failover, and greenroom times. Draft below, please react or reply with just changes you own.

Tom: +1. Quick question — are we doing a 20m keynote + 20m demo + 20m panel or 15/25/20? audience prefers shorter talks.

Priya: I vote 15/25/20 (shorter keynote, longer demo). More time to show cost/latency wins.

Ravi: 15/25/20 works. I'll take demo fallback setup (edge proxy & cached responses). Will add a script for the 5m failover.

Ava: Speaker confirmations: Sarah & Miguel confirmed. Need to nudge Oliver (product) — he said yes but hasn't sent slides. I can chase.

Ethan: I can host the panel and cover lead routing during Qs. Routing note: all demo leads go to SFDC campaign "webinar-march-26". Ops, please confirm mapping.

Ops: Confirmed. Zoom registration->SFDC mapping set. We will tag by "interest_level" and "demo_click". Also retention policy for recordings: 90 days (unless legal asks).

Leah: Run-of-show draft (timestamps are minutes from start):
```
0:00 - 0:02  - Welcome + housekeeping (Leah)
0:02 - 0:17  - Keynote: Why cost-aware inference matters (Sarah)
0:17 - 0:42  - Live demo: Redwood Dedicated vs Hosted (Miguel + Ravi)
0:42 - 0:56  - Panel: architecting for latency & cost (Oliver, Sarah, Miguel)
0:56 - 1:00  - Closing + CTA + lead routing (Leah + Ethan)
```
This gives a 60 minute total runtime. If we go 15/25/20 we shrink keynote to 15 and shift timings accordingly.

Tom: Suggest adding a 2-min audience poll after keynote to collect intent. Quick poll options: PoC, Scaling, Security. Helps routing.

Priya: Good call. Also propose a baked-in prompt test for demo (simple 50-token prompt) so we can show latency and cost numbers live. I'll write the prompt and the expected outputs.

Ravi: Demo failover plan (quick):
1) Primary: Dedicated pool — show throughput/latency numbers.
2) If error or timeout, switch to Hosted model variant (quantized) and show degraded but acceptable output.
3) If region degraded, fallback to EU region with warm KV cache.
I will commit a short script and a toggle we can flip in greenroom.

Ava: Timeline for rehearsals? We should do: 1) Tech check (30m) 2 days before, 2) Full dress rehearsal (60m) 1 day before, 3) Final mic check (15m) 1h before live. Can we lock calendar slots?

Leah: Yes. Proposing:
- Tue 10am PT: tech check
- Wed 9am PT: full dress
- Thu 9:45am PT: final mic check (live is 10am PT)
Who can't make any?

Miguel (via thread): I can't do Tue morning but can join Wed + Thu.

Ava: Noted. We'll swap tech check to Tue 4pm PT to accommodate.

Ethan: For the lead routing flow: after the poll and demo CTA, attendees who click "request demo" should get routed to SDR queue A for ARR > 100k and SDR queue B otherwise. We'll need a hidden field on reg form capturing ARR band. Ops, can SFDC do this?

Ops: Yes. We will create two queues and map by the "arr_band" field. Demo clicks get an activity logged and the campaign assigned.

Priya: Quick content ask — can marketing produce a 1-page benchmark infographic to drop in the panel slide deck and landing page? I can provide the numbers.

Leah: Yes. @Ava please coordinate with design. Deliverable by Mon EOD.

Ava: On it — will make two variants (long and compact) for slide + social.

Tom: Any compliance notes re: recording speakers? Oliver needs to sign off. Also check customer data in demos — use synthetic data.

Leah: Good catch. All demos use synthetic datasets. I'll send the recording consent form to speakers.

Ravi: I'll add a one-line script to zero out logs and scrub keys before the demo starts.

Leah: Outstanding actions (quick):
- Ava: design infographic + chase Oliver slides (Mon EOD)
- Priya: demo prompt + expected outputs (Fri)
- Ravi: failover toggle script + scrub script (Wed)
- Ethan: panel moderation + lead routing mapping confirmation (Ops)
- Ops: SFDC queues + registration mapping (Tue)
- All speakers: sign consent + upload slides (Wed noon)
Please reply with ack or question.

Tom: ack

Priya: ack — will post prompt in #marketing-assets when ready.

Ravi: ack — adding script to repo under /rehearsals/demo-fallbacks. Will ping when pushed.

Ava: ack — looping in design now.

Ethan: ack

Leah: Thanks everyone. Final reminder: dress rehearsal Wed 9am PT — calendar invite incoming. :sparkles:

ZoomBot: Recording scheduled for 2026-03-26 10:00 PT. Link: https://zoom.us/rec/abc123 (access restricted to org).
